Having officially entered the Kikuka-sho, 
Matikane Fukukitaru grows increasingly 
anxious about running a long-distance race 
for the first time.

Worried about Matikane Fukukitaru, Silence 
Suzuka offered her some words of support.

Machikane Fukukitaru is far more amazing 
than she realizes, and she needs to have 
more confidence in herself.

Gaining courage from those words, 
Matikanefukukitaru felt positive again, 
determined to fight with everything she 
had for the Kikuka Sho.
